models.collectorNote: Condition and documentation split the market: tired cars are projects, sorted low-mile cars with records are the collectible. The film connection guarantees an audience forever; buy on mechanical health, not nostalgia.

generations.name: DMC-12
generations.note: Roughly 9,000 were built before receivership in 1982. The PRV V6 — shared with Peugeot, Renault and Volvo — made 130 hp in US trim, so the car cruised better than it sprinted; the gullwing doors, not the pace, were the point.

models.intro: The only DeLorean: a Giugiaro wedge in brushed stainless steel over a Lotus-engineered backbone chassis, built in Northern Ireland with British government money. Underpowered, over budget, and — after Back to the Future — the most recognisable car of the 1980s.
